name: Lid-driven cavity
blurb: Gas in a square box with no-slip walls, its lid sliding to the right at speed 1: the lid drags a vortex into the box, and at Reynolds number 100 (viscosity 0.01) the flow settles into the steady state that Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982) tabulated, a standard check of viscous flow. The sound speed is 13, so the gas is nearly incompressible (Mach 0.08).

featured.label: Viscosity
featured.tip: Kinematic viscosity: the Reynolds number is lid speed x box / viscosity, 100 at 0.01. Above a few thousand the flow no longer settles
